title: Word: Copilot Agent Mode edits documents through chat
summary: The briefing passes: its roadmap facts, licence requirement and licence-assignment controls are supported. Searches did not establish a separate tenant switch, default state or usage rate for this roadmap item; the briefing appropriately distinguishes the later editing-by-default announcement.

claims.quote: Searched: Word Agent mode fair use; Agent mode Word license limits. Read Copilot overview, service description and Limits for features in Microsoft Copilot Chat; those pages do not specify an Agent Mode in Word limit.

claims.claim: Microsoft 365 admin center > Users > Active users > user > Licenses and Apps > Licenses reaches user licence assignment.
claims.quote: go to the Users > Active users page. ... Select the row of the user ... select Licenses and Apps. ... Expand the Licenses section, select the boxes for the licenses that you want to assign

claims.claim: Set-MgUserLicense -UserId $userUPN -AddLicenses @{SkuId = "<SkuId>"} -RemoveLicenses @() assigns a user licence through Microsoft Graph PowerShell.
claims.quote:
To assign a license to a user, use the following command in PowerShell.
Set-MgUserLicense -UserId $userUPN -AddLicenses @{SkuId = "<SkuId>"} -RemoveLicenses @()

claims.claim: Assigning licences in the admin centre requires at least License Administrator or User Administrator.
claims.quote: You must be at least a License or User Administrator to assign licenses.

claims.claim: Graph PowerShell licence assignment requires User.ReadWrite.All or another permission listed in the Assign license Graph reference.
claims.quote: Assigning and removing licenses for a user requires the User.ReadWrite.All permission scope or one of the other permissions listed in the 'Assign license' Microsoft Graph API reference page.
